beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Here are twelve cookies. Share them equally among three trays. How many cookies go on each tray?

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: One here, one here, one here. Every tray gets one.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Around again. Two on each.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Three on each.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Four on each. None left over.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: We knew three trays. We found four cookies on each!

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Same twelve cookies. This time, put three cookies on each tray. How many trays can we fill?

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Scoop three together. One tray.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Another three. Two trays.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Three more. Three trays.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The last three. Four trays, with none left over.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: We knew three cookies per tray. We found four trays.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Both are twelve divided by three equals four. But the fours count different things.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Sharing: four cookies on each. Grouping: four trays!

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Multiply to check. Three trays of four make twelve. Four trays of three also make twelve.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Division starts with the total and finds a missing part of that multiplication picture.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: A coach puts sixteen players into teams of four. How many teams are there?

do.text: A coach puts 16 players into teams of 4. How many teams are there?

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Groups of four. We're finding how many teams.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: One team, two teams, three teams, four teams.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Sixteen divided by four is four teams. Four teams of four players make sixteen.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: A teacher puts forty-five books on five shelves, the same number on each shelf. How many books are on each shelf?

do.text: A teacher puts 45 books on 5 shelves, the same number on each shelf. How many books are on each shelf?

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Five shelves are waiting. Share equally to find how many books on each.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Five times nine is forty-five. Nine books on every shelf use all forty-five books.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: So forty-five divided by five is nine books per shelf.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Dealing finds how many in each group. Scooping finds how many groups.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Listen to the story. What does it ask you to count?
